column1: # restrict_taxon: NCBI taxon id(s), semicolon-separated, that this rule applies to.
# Empty means the rule is universal. SPI-1 and SPI-2 are gene-symbol patterns for
# named Salmonella islands and are scoped to the Salmonella genus (taxon 590):
# sseA-sseL and sopB occur in other enterobacteria without implying those islands,
# and applying them genome-wide mislabelled clusters in Sakai, UTI89 and KPPR1.
# Two jobs: (i) supply weak supporting evidence from RefSeq product names and gene symbols,
# (ii) assign the functional subcategories used as cluster columns in CodonPipe workbooks.
# Patterns are Python regular expressions applied case-insensitively with re.search.
# Weights are deliberately low: at standard stringency a vocabulary match alone never
# creates a virulence call, it only corroborates database evidence.
# as_cluster     1 = this subcategory is reported as a gene-cluster column in the output
#                workbook; 0 = the rule contributes evidence only (it names an evidence
#                type, not a functional class of virulence factor).
# machinery      dedicated   = host-attack machinery with no known function outside a host
#                             (T3SS/T6SS apparatus and effectors, toxins, immune evasion)
#                dual_use    = host-facing but also serving environmental or biofilm
#                             functions (fimbriae and curli, flagella and chemotaxis,
#                             siderophores, O-antigen, capsule). Whether these belong in
#                             the strict tier is a biological judgement, so it is exposed
#                             as the strict_requires_dedicated parameter rather than fixed.
#                unclassified= not assigned; never excluded by the dedicated-only option

column8: Salmonella pathogenicity island 1 structural, regulatory and effector genes.
Salmonella pathogenicity island 2 and its translocated effectors.
Type III secretion machinery and effectors.
Shigella / EPEC-EHEC type III secretion nomenclature.
Non-T3SS/T6SS dedicated secretion systems. The housekeeping Sec and Tat pathways are deliberately excluded.
O-antigen is dispensable in vitro; lipid A and core biosynthesis are not, and are separated on the in-vitro axis.
Capsular polysaccharide, a canonical immune-evasion structure.
Metal acquisition under host-imposed restriction; mutants frequently also lose fitness in metal-poor media.
Flagellar and twitching motility: dispensable in broth, host-relevant and strongly immunogenic.
Direct interference with host immune effectors.
Survival and replication inside host cells.
Virulence regulators typically have pleiotropic in vitro phenotypes.
RefSeq curators label translocated effectors explicitly; this is strong, host-directed annotation evidence.
Product names in which the RefSeq annotation itself asserts a virulence or invasion role.
